positions.commentary: Amazon's influence on brick-and-mortar retailers was a key factor in the firm's deep value investment thesis regarding Abercrombie and Fitch.
The firm believes the loss of the Costco account would unlock capital for American Express to repurchase shares, driving EPS growth.
Costco could demand better terms from American Express, leading Amex to walk away from the business as a strength.
